title: feat: add reduce-log-volume skill
body:
## Summary
- Adds a new `reduce-log-volume` skill that analyzes log body patterns in Honeycomb to find high-volume message templates
- Generates OTel Collector `filter` processor config to drop noisy logs
- Includes reference doc for the OTel filter processor OTTL patterns
- Ported from a personal skill — adapted for plugin conventions (trigger phrases, MCP tool allowlist, no positional args)

## Test plan
- [x] Structural tests pass (52/52 via `make test`)
- [ ] Manual test: invoke skill against a real Honeycomb environment
